trades | CREATE TABLE trades(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts_open REAL, ts_close REAL,  symbol TEXT, entry REAL, exit REAL, qty REAL, exit_type TEXT, gross_pct REAL, fee_pct REAL,  net_pct REAL, net_usdt REAL, hold_sec REAL, obi REAL, spread_bp
events | CREATE TABLE events(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts REAL, symbol TEXT, kind TEXT,  price REAL, info TEXT)
signals | CREATE TABLE signals(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts REAL, symbol TEXT, obi REAL,  spread_bps REAL, mid0 REAL, mid30 REAL, mid60 REAL)
sigpaths | CREATE TABLE sigpaths(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts REAL, symbol TEXT, entry REAL,  ask REAL, obi REAL, spread_bps REAL, path TEXT)
paths | CREATE TABLE paths(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts REAL, symbol TEXT, entry REAL,  stop REAL, wall REAL, wall_usdt REAL, path TEXT)
levels | CREATE TABLE levels(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts REAL, symbol TEXT, kind TEXT,  price REAL, usdt REAL, tick REAL, dist REAL, path TEXT, ctx TEXT)
